description.value: Frankie's Italian Kitchen & Bar is a family-style southern Italian restaurant located inside the Georgian Court Hotel in downtown Vancouver, steps from BC Place and Rogers Arena. Named in honour of proprietor Raffaele's grandfather Francesco Raffaele Aiello, it serves house-made and imported pastas, daily fresh-stretched pizza dough, and a curated wine list spotlighting Italian and Okanagan Valley selections. The connected Frankie's Jazz Club across the street hosts live jazz and blues four nights per week.
